notes.title: Big news!
notes.content:
[h3]Frequently asked questions to Hobo King:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442438/1e72e8fc3cadf0ab97de1b1683ebe01c18ca903c.png[/img]

Q: When is the full game coming out?
A; We are aiming to launch it on June 1st but the date is not final.

Q: Can I use my Hobo Prophecy safe file for a full game?
A: No, these are two different games and with a new combat system it is not even possible to do that.

Q: What will be the price of the game?
A: The price is not finalised but it should be in the range of 15-20$.

Q: I have a game crashing bug and can't find the solution, what do I do?
A: Best option would be to join our discord channel or post it in Steam community. Don't forget to note your computer specifications, the language you are using, and add the Player.log file. Here's how you can find it. Path starts with Homebased/Garbage Hobo prophecy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39442438/1ef37e363a6da1fbf382da9c15829f7f733c7b72.png[/img]

Q: Will there be an update to Hobo Prophecy?
A: Yes, as soon as we balance it and test it out properly.

Q: Why Turkish version of the Hobo prophecy isn't working properly?
A: There is a bug in the localisation file, we will fix it in the next patch. For now, please choose the English version in the setting menu.

We've put much consideration into this decision to release the game as quickly as possible but the most important is to make a quality game. Right now we are finalising the game content and soon we will be able to start shaping it to the final form.

If you have any questions, suggestions or feedback feel free to share your thoughts in Steam community or discord!

[h3]More information about progress of full game development here:[/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1253710/announcements/detail/3010066662621690274

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
First of all our team would like to thank all of our players for support, feedback and suggestions. 
Every single question or review helped us to understand the most important issues and prioritize what needs to be fixed for the next update. Thanks for showing interest and being patient for the first update.

We did some big updates regarding the most often complaints:
[list]
[*] Massive improvements to path finding and bug fixes related to it.
[*] More optimisation for RAM usage
[*] Fixed bug with non responsive training/sleeping, torch where you get 100% warmth, UI hover container placement on all aspect ratios and countless non critical bugs
[*] Balancing: Reduced begging income, was too powerful, In Garbage invasion you no longer can be attacked by more fighters than you have, Grand Theft Trash now gives much more resources.
[/list]

Hopefully these fixes should improve the gaming experience for everyone who were disappointed. 

Another issue that should be addressed is the game difficulty and balancing.
Hobo Prophecy is a demo of full game Garbage and it is stated in the first sentence ''about this game''.
This game is intended to have a learning curve and might look difficult while playing it for the first time.
However because it is a demo we made it just a bit more difficult so we could use your feedback to balance the full game and improve the features that are not working as intended. 
Hobo Prophecy has 3 different endings, you can beat the game in 1 hour or play it for 40 hours (as some people did) without finishing the last quest. This demo is supposed to give you a small quantity of resources so you could get a glimpse of what to expect in the full game which is right now our priority.

If you have some difficulties to progress in the game we recommend you checking out some videos or discussions in our Steam community, we hope that will help you!

Right now we are working on the full game, adding more side quests, balancing the resources and overall home base management. One of top priority tasks is to totally change the fighting system and implement new fighting classes. We are planning to launch the game in around 3 months so thank you for all the patience and trust. If you have any urgent requests or issues that need to be solved you can always add us to friends on steam and have a chat or join our discord channel where we can reply you in real time.

We really hope that this update will improve the experience with our game for those who were disappointed. On the other hand it looks like players who enjoyed our game will have some great moments playing the full game because many things that were suggested are already in the full version!

If you find any bugs, have any suggestions, or want to know exactly what we are working on right now, there are pinned discussions in our Steam community.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1
notes.content:

The memory usage was decreased by 50% and now there should be less issues launching the game on Garbage Pc's.
